name: When do I need an engineering coordinator for my luxury home project?

mainEntity.name: When do I need an engineering coordinator for my luxury home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need an engineering coordinator early in the design phase, particularly for luxury homes with complex architectural features, extensive landscaping, or advanced smart home systems. Engaging a coordinator at the outset helps identify potential conflicts, optimize designs for efficiency, and streamline the permitting process. This proactive approach prevents costly delays and rework during construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engage an engineering coordinator early in the design phase for complex luxury home projects to identify conflicts and streamline the process.
